metadata.keywords: Absurdist space comedy, 16-bit pixel art, Retro game UI, Satirical sci-fi, Low-res chunky sprites, Bright limited palette, Cosmic slapstick, Crypto satire, Uranus jokes
metadata.style: Main aesthetic — 16-bit pixel art absurdism that matches the irreverent tone of Occupy Uranus. Think SNES-era space RPG meets shitposty sci-fi zine: chunky sprites, hard outlines, exaggerated expressions, and visual gags baked into every scene. Colors lean into bright, limited palettes (teals, magentas, toxic greens, neon blues) with simple shading and obvious dithering rather than smooth gradients. Space, ships, UI, and characters should feel like a lovingly janky retro game cartridge about a serious mission that refuses to take itself seriously.
